description: This file defines the Java entity class 'LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTag' which maps to the database table 'm_loan_installment_delinquency_tag'. It encapsulates information related to delinquency tags associated with loan installments, including references to delinquency range, loan, installment, as well as dates and outstanding amount. The class uses JPA annotations for ORM and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTag
classes.description: Entity class representing a delinquency tag associated with a loan installment, including fields for delinquency range, loan, installment, and relevant dates and amounts.
